messages:
ana: Heads up — onboarding LyraX-8B (Mistral lineage) to int4 perf suite. Seeing strong repeating tokens after ~2k tokens in summarization runs.

sam: repro please? sample prompt + command?

ana: Minimal repro attached. Command: `python run_gen.py --model lyrax-8b --quant int4 --max-tokens 2500 --seed 42 --task summarization`
Sample behavior: text starts repeating the phrase ‘the benefits of the’ around token ~2132 and keeps looping.

carla: fp16 baseline shows no repeat? same seed?

ana: fp16 clean. int8 flaky (rare), int4 deterministic repeat.

dmitri: Could be head ordering or rotary mapping mismatch after conversion. Any conversion warnings in logs?

ana: Conversion log notes: `WARN: rotary_scale mismatch default(1.0)->0.9 for head groups` and `info: proj_order preserved` but KV cache trace shows `kvcache_head_offset +1` for some heads.

sam: Try forcing a head swap in runtime to test: `--head-order 3:7,7:3` (swap head groups 3 and 7). If that fixes it, it's conversion ordering.

ana: Ran swap patch locally — repeats reduced but ROUGE dropped ~0.8 absolute vs fp16. Patch diff: small fix to the serialization mapping.

carla: Also check tokenizer normalization. Mistral-derived models sometimes used NFKC variants and combined diacritics causing token boundary shifts that manifest as long-context drift.

ana: Good call. Token diff: `python tools/token-diff.py --model lyrax --text samples/longctx.txt` -> 23 mismatched token splits; many involve ZWJ (\u200d) and composed vs decomposed accents (é vs é).

node-bot: eval-run queued: #5421 (fp16 baseline vs int4/raw vs int4+swap vs int4+nfkc) — ETA ~15m :hourglass:
messages_2:
ana: Quick logs from runtime: `kvcache: head=3 offset=1; rotary: angle_wrap detected head=7; kv_index mismatch at step 2100`.

dmitri: If tokenizer changes reduce token id drift, that may reduce the recurrence. But head permutation still smells like a proj-order/headmap mismatch. Two mitigations: (1) short-term: fallback policy for long requests to int8; (2) long-term: conversion script fix + tokenizer normalizer NFKC pass.

ana: Implemented fallback smoke: runtime flag `--quant-fallback-threshold 1500` which switches to int8 when request length > threshold. Running smoke now. Opened PR with conversion mapping patch: https://github.com/redwood/convert/pull/1234

sam: Nicely scoped. After evals, decide between head-swap permanent mapping vs fallback+tokenizer fix depending on quality vs cost.

node-bot: eval 5421 completed: metrics: fp16 rougeL=42.1; int4(raw)=38.6; int4+swap=40.3; int4+tokenfix=41.7; int4+fallback=41.8.

carla: Fallback looks best quality-wise. What about latency/cost for long requests?

ana: p50 +8ms, p99 +120ms on 2k-token runs when fallback triggers. Cost delta ~+18% unit cost for those requests.

dmitri: That's acceptable as an interim. Plan: land tokenizer normalizer + conversion patch, enable fallback feature-flag for lyrax-int4, monitor for 72h. If tokenizer patch makes int4 stable, disable fallback.

sam: Add a regression test in onboarding to catch this: `tests/onboard/lyrax_longctx_repro.txt` and a unit in convert CI that verifies headmap roundtrip.

ana: Done — PRs: convert patch (#1234), tokenizer-normalizer (#1235), runtime fallback toggle (#1236). Node-bot updated checklist.

node-bot: deploy-checklist updated: added `lyrax-int4-fallback` feature flag to staging and canary.

ana: Locking plan: merge tokenizer normalizer + convert fix -> enable fallback flag in staging -> run 72h smoke -> promote to canary -> observe. Will ping eng-sre if error rate > 2x baseline.

sam: Please paste the minimal repro curl command here so infra folks can run it locally.

ana: repro curl: `curl -sS -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d @repro_lyrax_longctx.json`

carla: Thx. Also add a small eval comparing perplexity over sliding windows to catch early drift in future onboards.

dmitri: agreed. I'll add the sliding-window perplexity job to onboarding harness.

sam: :thumbsup:
notes: short, operational thread covering model onboarding, quantization regressions, tokenizer edgecases, and an actionable mitigation plan (fallback + conversion/tokenizer fixes).
